follow_up_questions.question: Has the chest pain become more frequent, more severe, longer-lasting, or come on with less exertion or at rest recently?
follow_up_questions.why: A crescendo or rest pattern separates unstable from stable angina and determines whether outpatient work-up is safe.

follow_up_questions.question: When the pain comes on while walking, do you also get shortness of breath, sweating, nausea, lightheadedness or palpitations?
follow_up_questions.why: Associated symptoms were only asked about for the present moment, not during episodes.

follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any allergies, particularly to sulfa drugs or aspirin, and any history of stomach ulcers or bleeding?
follow_up_questions.why: Aspirin and hydrochlorothiazide were started without an allergy or bleeding-risk check.

follow_up_questions.question: Do you smoke, and when were your cholesterol levels last checked?
follow_up_questions.why: Smoking and lipids are key cardiovascular risk factors not covered in this chest pain visit.
